description.fr-FR: Choix de lettres de direction de Fénelon à des hommes (le duc de Chevreuse, le marquis de Fénelon, le duc de Bourgogne, des ecclésiastiques et d’autres), traduit en anglais par H. L. Sidney Lear (1880).
description.en-US: A selection of Fénelon’s letters of direction to men (the Duc de Chevreuse, the Marquis de Fénelon, the Duke of Burgundy, clergymen and others), translated by H. L. Sidney Lear (1880).
description.pt-BR: Seleção de cartas de direção de Fénelon a homens (o duque de Chevreuse, o marquês de Fénelon, o duque de Borgonha, eclesiásticos e outros), traduzida para o inglês por H. L. Sidney Lear (1880).

sources.edition: Spiritual Letters of Archbishop Fénelon: Letters to Men, tr. H. L. Sidney Lear, London: Rivingtons, 1880.
sources.description: archive.org OCR, lightly cleaned (running heads, hyphenation); residual OCR errors remain. Some letter headings are lost in the OCR; the ## subheads are the translator’s own subject lines.
